description: USDA and University of Arizona collaborators collected four free-air carbon-dioxide enrichment experiments on wheat at Maricopa, Arizona, from December 1992 to May 1997. The experiments vary water supply and nitrogen fertiliser under elevated carbon dioxide. The assembled records include management, soil and weather, physiology, phenology, biomass, leaf area, yield, crop quality, canopy temperature, soil moisture and nitrogen responses. The named Harvard Dataverse page opened publicly at version 7.1. It lists CC0 1.0 and spreadsheet, text and documentation files without a stated price. A food-supply modeller can test wheat-growth simulations and water-use responses to irrigation, fertiliser and carbon dioxide. These controlled plots use one cultivar at one desert site; they do not by themselves establish regional yield responses. Not every variable may be measured for every treatment or year. The files were not downloaded, so the precise table structure remains unchecked. This is related to, but distinct from, the multi-site wheat resources in G4-0566 and G4-0571. No catalogue identity match appeared in the full duplicate scan.
